unlisted_practices: Regulators should require ongoing, systematic post-market assessment of AI/ML device performance, including real-world evidence, rather than only surveillance of malfunctions and serious injuries.
Regulators should enable conditional clearance of AI/ML devices with appropriate guardrails and enforce completion of post-clearance confirmatory studies.
Regulators should evaluate AI/ML devices on clinical outcomes rather than only model metrics as devices become less verifiable and explainable.
Regulators should define when AI/ML device autonomy is acceptable and ensure appropriate escalation back to a radiologist or other clinician when necessary.
Regulators should establish more robust performance criteria and testing methods for the FDA 510(k) pathway.

screen.reason: This is an article/commentary addressing the regulatory challenges, oversight, and governance of AI/ML devices in radiology.
